practice_quiz.question: True or False: 'The collection of the most talented footballers in Ethiopia' is a well-defined set.
practice_quiz.explanation: Whether someone is 'most talented' is a matter of opinion, so it is impossible to say with certainty who belongs — the collection is not well-defined.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] እውነት or ሐሰት: 'The collection of the most talented footballers in Ethiopia' is a well-defined set.
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Whether someone is 'most talented' is a matter of opinion, so it is impossible to say with certainty who belongs — the collection is not well-defined. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: Which method of describing a set is being used when we write {x | x ∈ ℕ and x < 20}?
practice_quiz.explanation: This notation states a condition (x is a natural number less than 20) that x must satisfy, which is the defining feature of set-builder notation.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] Which method of describing a set is being used when we write {x | x ∈ ℕ and x < 20}?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] This notation states a condition (x is a natural number less than 20) that x must satisfy, which is the defining feature of set-builder notation. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: Is {0} an empty set?
practice_quiz.explanation: {0} contains one element, the number zero, so it is not empty. The empty set has zero elements and is written { } or ∅.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] Is {0} an empty set?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] {0} contains one element, the number zero, so it is not empty. The empty set has zero elements and is written { } or ∅. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: If set P = {2, 4, 6} and set Q = {6, 4, 2}, what is the relationship between P and Q?
practice_quiz.correct_answer: P and Q are equal sets (P = Q), because they contain exactly the same elements, regardless of the order they are written in.
practice_quiz.explanation: Order does not matter when comparing sets for equality — only the elements matter.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] If set P = {2, 4, 6} and set Q = {6, 4, 2}, what is the relationship between P and Q?
practice_quiz.correct_answer_amharic: [ትክክለኛ መልስ በአማርኛ] P and Q are equal sets (P = Q), because they contain exactly the same elements, regardless of the order they are written in.
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Order does not matter when comparing sets for equality — only the elements matter. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: How many subsets does the set K = {x, y, z} have?
practice_quiz.explanation: K has 3 elements, so the number of subsets is 2^3 = 8. These are: { }, {x}, {y}, {z}, {x,y}, {x,z}, {y,z}, {x,y,z}.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] How many subsets does the set K = {x, y, z} have?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] K has 3 elements, so the number of subsets is 2^3 = 8. These are: { }, {x}, {y}, {z}, {x,y}, {x,z}, {y,z}, {x,y,z}. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: Let A = {2, 3, 5} and B = {3, 5, 8, 9}. Find A ∩ B.
practice_quiz.explanation: The intersection keeps only the elements that appear in BOTH sets. Only 3 and 5 appear in both A and B.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] Let A = {2, 3, 5} and B = {3, 5, 8, 9}. Find A ∩ B.
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The intersection keeps only the elements that appear in BOTH sets. Only 3 and 5 appear in both A and B. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: If U = {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8} and A = {1,3,5,7}, what is A'?
practice_quiz.explanation: A' contains every element of U that is not in A. Removing 1,3,5,7 from U leaves the even numbers 2,4,6,8.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] If U = {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8} and A = {1,3,5,7}, what is A'?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] A' contains every element of U that is not in A. Removing 1,3,5,7 from U leaves the even numbers 2,4,6,8. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: According to De Morgan's Law, (A ∩ B)' is equal to which of the following? A) A' ∩ B'  B) A' ∪ B'  C) A ∪ B  D) A ∩ B
practice_quiz.explanation: De Morgan's second law states (A ∩ B)' = A' ∪ B' — complementing an intersection turns it into a union of the complements.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] According to De Morgan's Law, (A ∩ B)' is equal to which of the following? A) A' ∩ B'  B) A' ∪ B'  C) A ∪ B  D) A ∩ B
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] De Morgan's second law states (A ∩ B)' = A' ∪ B' — complementing an intersection turns it into a union of the complements. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: Let A = {a, b, c, d} and B = {b, d, e}. Find A∆B (symmetric difference).
practice_quiz.explanation: A - B = {a, c} (elements only in A). B - A = {e} (elements only in B). A∆B = {a,c} ∪ {e} = {a, c, e}.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] Let A = {a, b, c, d} and B = {b, d, e}. Find A∆B (symmetric difference).
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] A - B = {a, c} (elements only in A). B - A = {e} (elements only in B). A∆B = {a,c} ∪ {e} = {a, c, e}. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: If A = {1, 2} and B = {x, y, z}, how many ordered pairs are in A × B?
practice_quiz.explanation: The number of elements in a Cartesian product equals n(A) × n(B) = 2 × 3 = 6.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] If A = {1, 2} and B = {x, y, z}, how many ordered pairs are in A × B?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The number of elements in a Cartesian product equals n(A) × n(B) = 2 × 3 = 6. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: In a class of 50 students, 30 play football and 20 play basketball, and every student plays at least one of the two sports. How many students play both sports?
practice_quiz.explanation: Using n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B): 50 = 30 + 20 - n(A ∩ B), so n(A ∩ B) = 50 - 50 = 0. This means the two groups of players do not overlap at all.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] In a class of 50 students, 30 play football and 20 play basketball, and every student plays at least one of the two sports. How many students play both sports?
practice_quiz.explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Using n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B): 50 = 30 + 20 - n(A ∩ B), so n(A ∩ B) = 50 - 50 = 0. This means the two groups of players do not overlap at all. — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

practice_quiz.question: True or False: For any set A, A is a proper subset of itself.
practice_quiz.explanation: A proper subset requires A ⊆ B AND A ≠ B. Since a set is always equal to itself, no set is a proper subset of itself.
practice_quiz.question_amharic: [የመልስ ጥያቄ በአማርኛ] እውነት or ሐሰት: For any set A, A is a proper subset of itself.
